reviews.text: Really great service today. We found a large cat tree in store but had no way of getting it back home, they kindly agreed to deliver it to us. Less than an hour later we get a phone to say it would be with us shortly. 1 hour 5 minutes after we purchased it in the store, it was delivered to our home. Our cat Luna already absolutely loves her new climbing tree. Really fair price too. Thanks so much for a great service, and for exceeding ours (and Luna's) expectations. Chris and Matt :)
Great selection of cat toys & treats- which is what we came in for, & a lot more. Friendly staff too.
THANK YOU

I come here regularly on my own to buy my dog some of the little treats at the front next to the counter. I sometimes have a look around, I sometimes don’t. On two different occasions, I’ve come in with my partner and both times we have had a staff member (not too sure if it’s the same one) stop what they’re doing and immediately move further down the counter, pretending to do something else, whilst watching us. It’s only when I come in with my partner, does this happen. It’s very unwelcoming and rather discriminating. I shall assume it’s because he was wearing a puffer coat and a beanie hat (it’s December) as I didn’t see the staff member going out of her way to watch the other customers have a look around. I’ve got a dog, cats and a rabbit which is why I have a look around the whole shop, it’s also nice to have a look at the birds they have. Not that I should have to explain why I had a look at all five isles. However, we won’t be coming here again. Manners and politeness cost nothing. If you cannot trust your customers, you could install cctv so you can watch them on a screen so people don’t feel so judged. Nobody wants to put a £2 meaty dog chew up their sleeve, we would much rather pay and take it in a bag. Thankyou :)
Friendly and knowledgeable staff who are always happy to help and seem to really prioritise animal welfare. The store itself has lots of good stock for a range of animals :)

Purchased a hamster from here, and had a wonderful experience. I had reserved my hamster a few days prior, no problems, and paid for a cage and accessories to ensure my hamster had everything it needed. Picked up a few days later, amazing! I also have purchased a few toys and dog treats for my dogs, and they loved them. The staff are incredible, great pet shop, definitely recommend.

I'm here to buy pet supplies. I'm an international student, and the staff was very unfriendly. I feel offended, and they gave me the wrong change—short by one pound in coins. I suggest changing the staff member; someone like this wouldn't make it in my country. I won't come back and will advise all my fellow students to avoid your store.
